claim: Courchevel Aventure offers 1-hour evening snowmobile (motoneige) rides above the altiport, 1-2 people per machine, at €350 private or €200 group per snowmobile, passengers from age 8 and drivers needing a valid license.
quote: 1 hour of snowmobiling... 1 to 2 people per snowmobile... Private Ride: €350 / SNOWMOBILE... Group Ride: €200 / SNOWMOBILE... The passenger must be at least 8 years old

claim: Snowmobiling in Courchevel runs on a secure 700-metre circuit and as night rides through spruce forests after the ski area closes, operated by Courchevel Aventure based at Courchevel 1850.
quote: A secure 700-meter circuit for children and adults... Night rides when the ski area closes, in the calm of snow-covered nature, between spruce forests, enchanting clearings and gentle slopes

claim: The Moriond Racing toboggan run is 3 km with 450 m vertical drop, costs €17 per run (with a €160 deposit), and is open 13 January to 2 April 2026; under 1.10 m not permitted.
quote: 3km of pure adrenalin... 450m of vertical drop... 17€ /run... 160€ deposit... from 13 January to 2 April 2026... Children under 1.10m are not permitted

claim: Beyond Moriond Racing, Courchevel offers a 2 km toboggan run from Courchevel 1850 down through fir trees to Courchevel Village, plus dedicated children's sledding areas at 1850 and La Tania.
quote: 2 km course through snow-covered fir trees to Courchevel Village... Dedicated areas for children are available at Courchevel 1850 and Courchevel La Tania

claim: Dog sledding (chiens de traineaux) in Courchevel is offered by Raquette Evasion, musher Christophe Sujdovic and Courchevel Aventure, with daytime rides at Plan du Vah (approx 25 min) and evening rides at Plantret (around 45 min).
quote: Raquette Evasion... Christophe Sujdovic... Courchevel Aventure... Daytime at Plan du Vah - approx. 25 minutes... Evening at Plantret - around 45 minutes

claim: Smiles Parapente offers winter tandem flights over Courchevel from the Pas du Lac 2 cable car: Sensation/Horizon at €140 (10-20 min) and Premium at €180 (20-30 min), taking off on skis or snowboard.
quote: Horizon €140 15-20 min... Sensation €140 10-15 min... Premium €180 20-30 min... Cable car Pas du Lac 2 in Courchevel and Méribel

claim: Ice karting (karting sur glace) at the Courchevel 1850 ice rink runs 7-minute sessions for max 6 people, minimum age 8 and height 1m40, available 14/12/2025 to 06/04/2026 on Wednesdays between 7pm and 9pm.
quote: Minimum age 8 years, minimum height 1m40... Session duration: 7 minutes... Maximum 6 people per session... from 14/12/2025 to 06/04/2026 on Wednesday between 7 pm and 9 pm

claim: Courchevel's sledding-and-gliding lineup also includes airboarding (an inflatable sled ridden headfirst) and snakegliss (a single-file group sledding train).
quote: Airboarding - an inflatable sled that propels you headfirst for a rush of adrenaline... Snakegliss - a group sledding experience in a single file

claim: Courchevel's official winter activity menu includes snowshoeing (raquettes) off the beaten path and night-time sledding/tobogganing alongside paragliding and dog sledding.
quote: venture off the beaten path with snowshoeing... enjoy night-time sledding... soar over the peaks on a paragliding adventure... experience the life of a musher on a dog sledding expedition
